Container.Name: Reprise
Container.Overview: Reprise finds intros and credits that repeat across your Plex TV episodes and lets you review them before anything is skipped. First start: open the Web UI, create your account, then follow the Setup guide. Review only by default: your media is shared read-only and no Plex folder is shared, so Reprise cannot write into Plex's database or folders. Sending results to Plex is optional and needs the two optional Plex folder fields (steps are in the README). Still in development, so review what it finds and keep sending to Plex off until you trust it. The image is pinned to one published build; to update, pick a newer published image digest.

Config.Name: Media
Config.Description: The folder that holds your videos, shared read-only so Reprise can read your files and never change them. Required. If Plex calls this folder something else, add a path mapping in Reprise (see the README).

Config.Name: Media 2 (optional)
Config.Description: Optional second media folder, shared read-only. Leave empty if one folder holds all your videos.

Config.Name: Plex folder (optional, for sending)
Config.Description: Leave empty for review only. Only needed to send results to Plex. Share Plex's whole "Plex Media Server" folder here (the one that holds Preferences.xml), using the same host path Plex itself uses. Back up Plex's database first. Steps: https://github.com/nphil/reprise#turn-on-sending-to-plex

Config.Name: Plex folder variable (optional, for sending)
Config.Description: Leave empty for review only. Set to /plex only together with the Plex folder above, and only to send results to Plex. Sharing the folder does not set this by itself. Case matters: /plex is not /Plex.

Config.Name: NVIDIA GPU UUID (optional)
Config.Description: Optional NVIDIA GPU for analysis video decoding (NVDEC). Leave void for none. To use one, set its UUID (nvidia-smi -L on the host) and add --runtime=nvidia to Extra Parameters; Reprise falls back to the CPU on any GPU problem.

Config.Name: NVIDIA driver capabilities
Config.Description: NVIDIA runtime capabilities; video supplies the NVDEC library. Keep this in the variable field, not as a bare Extra Parameters assignment. No effect while the GPU UUID is void.

Config.Name: Working folder
Config.Description: Writable storage-backed scratch folder with at least 1 GiB free. Configuration validation creates it if needed; avoid the small /tmp tmpfs for processing scratch.
